integrity: The sharpness classification is proved analytically. Exact rational computation is supplemental and is not used to infer an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact value and optimizer of \(L_p(v)\) at noninteger variance ratios are not determined.
The theorem is specific to a nondegenerate Bernoulli signal; the zero-multiplicity argument is not asserted for arbitrary bounded signals.
Older discrete-regression characterization literature is only partly searchable in full text, so a differently phrased equivalent theorem remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact sharpness spectrum for Bernoulli least-favorable noise
